sections.title: Prosperity and Magnetic Energy

summary: Jeanne Bliss outlines five core decisions that distinguish beloved companies in their relationships with customers and employees: believe, with suspending cynicism; decide with clarity of purpose and align actions to a higher service-oriented promise; be real by shedding corporate veneer and creating an environment where employees can bring their best selves; be there by showing up for customers every day in ways that earn their loyalty; and repair the emotional connection after mistakes, moving beyond perfunctory apologies. Bliss links these practices to both financial prosperity and the prosperity of the human spirit, noting that genuine care generates customer loyalty and a energetic, magnet-like workplace culture. The talk contrasts sincere, repair-focused apologies with hollow ones and cites two years of research supporting the link between deliberate people-first decisions and better outcomes.
title: Jeanne Bliss: Five Decisions Beloved Companies Make
topics: Magnetic Energy of customers and employees
Two years of research on customer- and employee-centric organizations
